title: Trelawny Brown (Radiographer) — Interim Order Application
text:
Order:
ORDER: The Registrar is directed to suspend the name of Trelawny Brown from the Register on an interim basis for a period of 18 months.

Notes:
This order will be reviewed by the Committee no later than 15 June 2026 or earlier if new evidence which is relevant to the Order becomes available after it was made.
court: Health and Care Professions Tribunal Service
